method: The eventCatalog of the real get_hooks_listing answer, 2026-10-03, free (control request only, 20 ms — the fastest control of that run). Raw recording: C:/Users/you/ccui-ctxprobe/ctx-probe-result.json, key hooks_listing.data.eventCatalog, copied VERBATIM in the delivered (lifecycle) order. Counter-check in the binary: the identical 33-name list stands twice as an array literal (kg @204512305, P0 @205427002) with the same order and the same names.
caveat: Counts are to be COUNTED off eventCatalog, never quoted from prose. The first draft of PR-11 wrote "22 of the 33" and "five of the nine on offer" in four places; measured it is 23 of 33 (ten take none), and SEVEN of the nine the editor used to offer take a matcher - five of those seven being the ones the old hint denied. That is why this file exists instead of a number in a comment.
